results.name: House of Student Raises $2 Mn Seed Funding to Expand Global Student Housing Platform
results.content:
## ✦ Summary  
**Global student living technology startup House of Student has raised $2 million in a seed funding round through a combination of equity anddebt.**  
The seed round was co-led by Saltwater Sutra and Nirmitsu Inspirational Ventures, with participation from Gautam Verlekar, Glen Fernandes, Richard McCallum, Ali Moosa, and existing investor Unilodgers.  
The Gurugram and US-based company will utilise the fresh capital to enhance its technology platform, expand its global housing inventory, strengthen AI capabilities and accelerate international expansion across key student education destinations.  
Read Also - [Inflexor Ventures Raises Rs 400 Crore in First Close of Its Third Venture Capital Fund](https://viestories.com/funding-alert/inflexor-ventures-raises-rs-400-crore-in-first-close-of-its-third-venture-capital-fund-12207286)
## About House of Student  
Founded in February 2025 by Vaibhav Verma, House of Student operates a global student accommodation technology platform. The company enables students to search, book, and manage accommodation across major international education destinations. It also plans to introduce AI-enabled student support services to improve the overall overseas education experience.  
House of Student currently offers access to more than 2.5 million verified student rooms across 25+ countries, including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the UAE, Singapore, and several European markets.
## Founder Comment  
“We never started with the ambition of building an accommodation company,” said Verma. “We started because we believed students deserved better. Student housing was simply the first problem we could solve. Today, our ambition is much bigger. We want to become the world's most trusted company around student life.”
